verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing schedules recurring work only within its billing domain. It automates recurring subscription charges and renewals, retries failed payments automatically, and offers 'Billing automations' that drive customer communications. Nothing shows a general way to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, so this is billing-specific recurrence rather than open-ended scheduling. Missing for 10: general-purpose job/workflow scheduling (cron-like triggers, custom actions), detailed docs on configuring Billing automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automation workflows.
